flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/android then Assert the page heading says "Mlyfo on your Android phone"
Assert the page shows a "Download the keyboard" button
Assert the page explains how to install the Mlyfo app from Chrome
Assert the page says internet is the keyboard's only permission and keystrokes never leave the phone
Assert the "Check your download" section shows a long SHA-256 fingerprint
Go to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/manifest.webmanifest
Assert the page shows the app name "Mlyfo" and "standalone" display

remark: analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'the "Check your download" section shows a long SHA-256

assert: the page shows a "Download the keyboard" button

assert: the page says internet is the keyboard's only permission and keystrokes never le

wait: PRIMARY: wait for the manifest page to load
assert: the page shows the app name "Mlyfo" and "standalone" display
